plant.hardinessNote: Hardy through an average UK winter, approximately -10 to -5°C; shelter from cold winds in colder areas.

plant.prune: Trim lightly after the spring flush and again in late summer to trigger fresh red growth; avoid cutting in frosty weather.
plant.resilience: Tough, compact evergreen once established, good for low hedges and screening. Leaf spot can mar foliage in wet years. Pests: occasional aphids; prone to leaf spot and powdery mildew.
